{{Top}}
[[File:EspionageDroid.jpg|A MerenData espionage droid.|thumb|200px|right]]
'''Spy droids''' were a classification of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that were used for covert surveillance and espionage. Several broad classes of spy droid were [[Slicer droid/Legends|slicer droids]], [[Surveillance droid/Legends|surveillance droids]] (used for listening and surveillance), and [[espionage droid]]s, which were used for covert infiltration and often mimicked other droids.
